scope: Principal article tables, full scientific records and every NPZ array archive in the accuracy public package. Legacy galaxy snapshots are separately described in their per-study methods and manifests; this registry does not claim to release private initial conditions.

columns.population: Named initial physical weight; no unit-mass renormalization
columns.time: Dimensionless endpoint T; only 10 and 20 are recorded
columns.cutoff: Physical taper cutoff in x, not numerical domain
columns.response: Dimensionless accumulated noise-minus-smooth integral(w K_B dx)
columns.ci95_low: Lower pointwise Student-t sampling limit, 8 independent batches
columns.numerical_window_qualified: Historical timestep/window decision, distinct from statistical interval
columns.pointer: RFC6901 pointer to complete original row

datasets.missing_values: JSON null means unavailable or inapplicable, never zero. No inferred imputation. CSV boolean fields use True/False.
datasets.sampling_and_pairing: Eight independent seeded batches; population/time/window contractions share paths. Pointwise Student-t intervals where stated; paired numerical differences remain proxies.
datasets.license: Benchmark-derived numerical records: MIT where covered by the benchmark license; third-party sources retain their own terms.

columns.rows[].plot.plugin_allowance: Integrated absolute plug-in contribution before kernel uncertainty
columns.display: Fine-cell products are summed BEFORE averaging; multiplying displayed mean curves is not equivalent
columns.counts: Correlated comparison counts, not independent regimes
